SURESH J AI & RPA Engineer n suresh206ram@gmail.com | n +91 63827 50176 | LinkedIn | GitHub

Professional Summary

Results-driven AI & RPA Engineer with 3.5+ years of expertise in Microsoft Power Platform and intelligent automation. Proven track record of delivering 80+ automation projects and processing 50K+ data records through AI-powered workflows. Specialized in transforming business processes through innovative AI agents, RPA solutions, and custom applications that drive operational efficiency and cost reduction.

Core Competencies

AI & Automation

AI Agents & Chatbots: OpenAI GPT, Copilot Studio, Perplexity, Gemini, Meta AI RPA Platforms: Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Zapier, Pabbly Connect, Make.com Document Processing: AI Builder for intelligent data extraction

Microsoft Power Platform

Power Automate: Complex workflows, API integrations, scheduled automations Power Apps: Canvas & Model-driven apps, solutions architecture, role management Power BI: Interactive dashboards, real-time analytics, data visualization

Development & Integration

Programming: JavaScript, VB Script, Google Apps Script, SQL Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, REST APIs Databases: SQL Server, Dataverse, SharePoint integration Cloud Platforms: AWS VM deployment, Microsoft 365 ecosystem

Design & Analytics

UI/UX Design: Figma prototyping, responsive design Analytics: Excel Power Query, Google Sheets automation, Zoho Analytics Project Management: Team leadership, process optimization, technical documentation

Professional Experience

Senior AI and RPA Developer

Cognet HR Solutions, Chennai (On-Site) | October 2024 – Present

(cid:127) Led a team of 6 RPA developers, achieving a 95% project success rate. (cid:127) Developed an AI-powered lead generation system processing 50K+ emails and LinkedIn profiles. (cid:127) Built an enterprise automation portal using Power Apps model-driven architecture with Teams integration. (cid:127) Created real-time Power BI dashboards providing live project analytics and KPI tracking. (cid:127) Deployed multi-client RPA solutions across AWS VMs with automated scheduling and monitoring.

Senior Power Platform Developer

Sparkfuse, Delhi (Remote) | March 2024 – October 2024

(cid:127) Automated repetitive business processes reducing manual effort by 70%. (cid:127) Developed custom Power Apps solutions improving user productivity and engagement. (cid:127) Created comprehensive analytics dashboards from raw Excel data for executive reporting. (cid:127) Built intelligent chatbots using Chatfuel and Voiceflow for customer support automation.

Power Platform Developer

Tranz1 Digital, Chennai (Remote) | August 2023 – March 2024

(cid:127) Streamlined business workflows through Power Automate integration across multiple platforms. (cid:127) Created interactive Power BI dashboards providing actionable insights from complex datasets. (cid:127) Enhanced team collaboration through SharePoint–Power Apps integration solutions.

Software Engineer Intern

Pratian Technologies, Bangalore (On-Site) | June 2023 – August 2023

(cid:127) Conducted technical research and created documentation for software engineering best practices. (cid:127) Collaborated with SMEs to produce high-quality technical content for publication. (cid:127) Utilized Power BI, SQL, and Excel for data visualization and analysis projects.

Java Full Stack Intern

Inmakes Infotech, Kochi (Remote) | September 2022 – March 2023

(cid:127) Contributed to two live full-stack Java projects using Spring Boot and Hibernate. (cid:127) Developed responsive frontend interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap. (cid:127) Implemented secure database interactions using JDBC and SQL optimization.

Featured Projects

AI-Powered Lead Generation System

Engineered intelligent RPA workflow processing 50K+ professional profiles. Integrated AI agents for data validation and enrichment and achieved 95% data accuracy with automated quality checks.

Enterprise Document Migration Platform

Automated file transfers across multiple client portals and cloud storage with continuous monitoring, error handling and notifications. Reduced manual processing time by 80%.

Automation Request Portal

Built a comprehensive ticketing system using Power Apps model-driven architecture with approvals in Teams and email notifications, plus a real-time analytics dashboard for resource management.

LinkedIn & Indeed Talent Scraper

Developed intelligent candidate data extraction system with validation and deduplication, automated storage to Excel/Google Sheets and real-time synchronization.

Education

Master of Science in Computer Science (2020 – 2022) | CGPA: 8.3/10

Certifications

(cid:127) AI Generalist Accelerator Program - Outskill

(cid:127) Microsoft Power Platform - Udemy

(cid:127) Java Development - Inmakes Infotech

(cid:127) Software Testing - NPTEL, IIT Kharagpur

(cid:127) MATLAB - JMC, Trichy

(cid:127) Ethical Hacking with Python - Pantech ProEd

Key Achievements

(cid:127) 80+ successful automation projects delivered across multiple industries.

(cid:127) 50K+ data records processed through AI-powered workflows.

(cid:127) Led a team of 6 RPA developers, achieving a 95% project success rate.

(cid:127) Reduced manual processing time by 70-80% through intelligent automation.

(cid:127) Achieved 95% data accuracy in AI-driven data extraction systems.

Available for immediate onboarding | Open to relocation and remote roles
